author: Ubisoft YouTube
text:
Ubisoft at gamescom 2026: Wrap-up video
That's a wrap on Ubisoft at Gamescom 2026! 🎬

Five days, one incredible community. Relive the best moments from the Ubisoft Community Lounge in Cologne - the reveals, the reactions, and the fans who made it unforgettable.

Want to see more? Check out the daily VOD videos:
- Day 1: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6FDVYAaYKdI
- Day 2: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Tejm1LNqv9o
- Day 3: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cJxkiWUatfw
- Day 4: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SG0zeVMWhDI

Featuring: Rainbow Six Siege, Rainbow Six Tactics, Anno 117: Pax Romana, Rayman Legends Retold, The Division 2, Assassin's Creed Shadows, Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced, Morbid Metal, The Crew Motorfest, For Honor, Heroes of Might and Magic III Remake, and more.

Thank you to everyone who joined us in person or on stream – hope to see you next year! 💖
#Gamescom2026 #Ubisoft
